meta.name: Jay BIPU Content Idea Tournament — History Round
meta.pain_first_rule: An idea can only win by demonstrating the reader's pain more precisely than its opponent. Solution quality scores nothing until pain recognition scores.
meta.provenance: Ideas synthesized from recent project themes in agent history and the Jay Yang copywriting essay. Raw private transcripts, credentials, and identifiers are not included.

format.round1: Within each pod, ideas face off pairwise; winners advance.
format.final: Pod champions meet in cross-pod round-robin judged by all archetypes.
format.scoring: Each judge returns pain_recognition (0-5), specificity (0-5), action_pull (0-3). Pain recognition is weighted double and gates: if tied or losing on pain recognition, an idea cannot win regardless of other axes.
format.tiebreak: Higher pain_recognition, then higher specificity, then earlier seed order.
